entry.en: Passports must expire at least 3 months after arrival and have at least 2 blank pages for entry stamps.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe vencer al menos 3 meses después de la llegada y tener al menos 2 páginas en blanco para sellos de entrada.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank pages for entry stamps.

entry.en: Travellers also going to South Africa need 2 additional blank pages in the passport.
entry.es: Quienes también viajen a Sudáfrica necesitan 2 páginas en blanco adicionales en el pasaporte.
entry.quote: If you’re also travelling to South Africa, your passport must have 2 additional blank pages.

entry.en: Entry is denied to those without a valid travel document or with a passport reported lost or stolen.
entry.es: Se niega la entrada a quien no tenga un documento de viaje válido o use un pasaporte reportado como perdido o robado.
entry.quote: You will be denied entry if you do not have a valid travel document or try to use a passport that has been reported lost or stolen.

entry.en: Passport stamp dates should be checked, because incorrect dates may lead authorities to stop re-entry for up to a year.
entry.es: Hay que revisar las fechas del sello del pasaporte, pues si son incorrectas las autoridades pueden impedir el reingreso hasta por un año.
entry.quote: Check the stamp in your passport has the correct date. If you do not have the correct dates, the Eswatini authorities may stop you from re-entering the country for up to a year.

entry.en: Travellers by air may need to complete a health form, and health questions are asked at the land border and King Mswati III International Airport.
entry.es: Quien viaje por aire puede tener que llenar un formulario de salud, y se hacen preguntas de salud en la frontera terrestre y en el aeropuerto internacional King Mswati III.
entry.quote: You may need to complete a health form if travelling by air. You will be asked health related questions on arrival at the land border and at King Mswati III International Airport.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si se llega desde un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

safety.en: There can be casual theft, pickpocketing and occasional muggings, particularly at the edges of towns and cities and at night.
safety.es: Puede haber hurtos, carteristas y asaltos ocasionales, sobre todo en las afueras de pueblos y ciudades y de noche.
safety.quote: There can be casual theft, pickpocketing and occasional muggings, particularly at the edges of towns and cities, and at night.

safety.en: Walking in the downtown areas of Mbabane and Manzini after dark should be avoided.
safety.es: Se debe evitar caminar por el centro de Mbabane y Manzini después del anochecer.
safety.quote: avoid walking in the downtown areas of Mbabane and Manzini after dark

safety.en: Protests and strikes occur occasionally, and security forces police them heavily and have used force on occasions.
safety.es: Ocasionalmente hay protestas y huelgas, que las fuerzas de seguridad vigilan intensamente y a veces han usado la fuerza.
safety.quote: Public protests, demonstrations, and strikes do occur occasionally in Eswatini, mostly in response to political or economic issues. Security forces police such events heavily and have used force on occasions.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in Eswatini, and LGBT+ people experience discrimination.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo es ilegal en Esuatini, y las personas LGBT+ sufren discriminación.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in Eswatini. LGBT+ people experience discrimination

safety.en: Animals stray onto rural roads and cause serious accidents and deaths, and driving on rural roads at night should be avoided.
safety.es: Los animales invaden las carreteras rurales y causan accidentes graves y muertes, y se debe evitar conducir de noche en ellas.
safety.quote: Take care driving in rural areas as animals stray on to roads and cause serious accidents and deaths. Avoid driving on rural roads at night

safety.en: Public transport can be dangerous because of poor driving standards, poor vehicles and poor road conditions.
safety.es: El transporte público puede ser peligroso por los malos estándares de conducción, los vehículos deficientes y el mal estado de las carreteras.
safety.quote: Travel by public transport can be dangerous due to poor standards of driving, lack of rest periods for drivers, the poor quality of vehicles and poor road conditions.

health.en: Basic healthcare is available, but there are shortages of common medicines, and serious emergencies would likely need treatment in South Africa.
health.es: Hay atención médica básica, pero escasean medicamentos comunes, y las emergencias graves probablemente requerirían atención en Sudáfrica.
health.quote: Basic healthcare is available in Eswatini, but there are shortages of common medicines. For serious accidents and emergencies or specialised treatment, it’s likely you would need to go to South Africa.

health.en: Travellers should have adequate health insurance and accessible funds to cover medical evacuation to South Africa and repatriation.
health.es: Se debe tener un seguro de salud adecuado y fondos accesibles para cubrir la evacuación médica a Sudáfrica y la repatriación.
health.quote: Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of medical evacuation to South Africa and repatriation.

health.en: Wikivoyage states that Eswatini has the highest HIV/AIDS prevalence in the world, at 25-26% of adults aged 15 to 49.
health.es: Wikivoyage afirma que Esuatini tiene la mayor prevalencia de VIH/sida del mundo, con 25-26% de los adultos de 15 a 49 años.
health.quote: Eswatini has the highest HIV/AIDS prevalence rate in the world – 25–26% of Swazi adults aged between 15 and 49 have HIV/AIDS

health.en: There are risks of bilharzia in infected streams and seasonal malaria risk in the north-east near Mozambique.
health.es: Hay riesgo de bilharziosis en arroyos infectados y riesgo estacional de malaria en el noreste cerca de Mozambique.
health.quote: There are risks for bilharzia if you frequent infected streams, as well as seasonal risks for malaria in the North-East parts of Eswatini near Mozambique.

health.en: Tap water is potable in major cities but may not be in rural areas.
health.es: El agua del grifo es potable en las ciudades principales, pero puede no serlo en zonas rurales.
health.quote: Tap water is potable in major cities but may not be in rural areas.

help.en: The emergency numbers are ambulance 977, fire 933 and police 999.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son ambulancia 977, bomberos 933 y policía 999.

getting_in.en: The only international airport is King Mswati III International Airport (SHO), which has flights to Cape Town, Durban, Johannesburg, Harare and Lusaka.
getting_in.es: El único aeropuerto internacional es el King Mswati III (SHO), con vuelos a Ciudad del Cabo, Durban, Johannesburgo, Harare y Lusaka.
getting_in.quote: The only international airport in Eswatini is King Mswati III International Airport (SHO IATA) also called Sikhuphe

getting_in.en: Ngwenya/Oshoek is the most popular border post from South Africa and tends to be crowded around long weekends and holidays.
getting_in.es: Ngwenya/Oshoek es el paso fronterizo más popular desde Sudáfrica y suele estar lleno en fines de semana largos y feriados.
getting_in.quote: The Ngwenya/Oshoek Border Post (on the N17/MR3 from Ermelo to Mbabane) tends to be full of people around long weekends and holidays, since it is the most popular border post.

getting_in.en: Mahamba border post near Piet Retief is handy from the south or north-west, and there is a 50 rand road toll.
getting_in.es: El paso de Mahamba, cerca de Piet Retief, es práctico desde el sur o el noroeste, y hay un peaje de 50 rand.
getting_in.quote: Mahamba border post near Piet Retief is handy when coming from south (Durban) or north-west (Johannesburg). Operations are rather quick. There is a 50 rand road toll.

getting_in.en: Most public transport buses arrive in Mbabane or Manzini.
getting_in.es: La mayoría de los autobuses de transporte público llegan a Mbabane o Manzini.
getting_in.quote: Most public transport bus services arrive in Mbabane or Manzini.

getting_around.en: The quickest way around the country is by car, and the whole country can be covered in one day.
getting_around.es: La forma más rápida de moverse por el país es en coche, y se puede recorrer todo en un día.
getting_around.quote: the quickest way to get around the country is by car. You can easily cover the whole country in one day this way.

getting_around.en: Minibuses called kombis are prevalent, but can be confusing.
getting_around.es: Los minibuses llamados kombis son comunes, pero pueden resultar confusos.
getting_around.quote: Minibuses, called kombis, are prevalent, but can be confusing.

getting_around.en: Larger Sprinter vans are a safer and faster choice than kombis if available.
getting_around.es: Las furgonetas Sprinter más grandes son una opción más segura y rápida si están disponibles.
getting_around.quote: The larger Sprinter vans are a safer and faster choice if available.

getting_around.en: Travel is very difficult after dark and the only option is by taxi, whose drivers may overcharge.
getting_around.es: Viajar es muy difícil después del anochecer, la única opción es el taxi, y los taxistas pueden cobrar de más.
getting_around.quote: Travel is very difficult after dark. The only option is by taxi. If staying around Mbabane or Manzini, keep a couple of cab drivers' phone numbers on hand. Taxi drivers may overcharge.

getting_around.en: Traffic drives on the left and the road is only partially in good condition and paved.
getting_around.es: El tráfico circula por la izquierda y la carretera solo está en parte en buen estado y pavimentada.
getting_around.quote: Traffic is on the left. The road is partially in good condition and paved.

getting_around.en: Driving after dark should be avoided, and the N4 via Oshoek is flagged for carjacking risk at night.
getting_around.es: Se debe evitar conducir de noche, y la N4 por Oshoek se señala por riesgo de robo de vehículos de noche.
getting_around.quote: On the N4 road from South Africa via the Oshoek border post, avoid driving after dark due to the risk of carjacking.

money.en: The currency is the lilangeni (plural emalangeni, SZL), tied to the South African rand at par.
money.es: La moneda es el lilangeni (plural emalangeni, SZL), vinculado al rand sudafricano a la par.
money.quote: The currency of Eswatini is called the lilangeni (plural: "emalangeni"), denoted by the symbol "L" for one, or "E" for more than one (ISO code: SZL). It is tied to the South African rand at par

money.en: All Swazi vendors will take rand, but no South African vendors will take emalangeni.
money.es: Todos los vendedores suazis aceptan rand, pero ningún vendedor sudafricano acepta emalangeni.
money.quote: All Swazi vendors will take rand, but no South African vendors will take emalangeni.

money.en: It is impossible to exchange emalangeni at Johannesburg Airport or in the UK.
money.es: Es imposible cambiar emalangeni en el aeropuerto de Johannesburgo o en el Reino Unido.
money.quote: It is impossible to exchange your emalangeni at Johannesburg Airport or in the UK.

money.en: Kombi operators do not take rand coins.
money.es: Los operadores de kombis no aceptan monedas de rand.
money.quote: Kombi operators in Eswatini do not take Rand coins.

etiquette.en: Swazis are very loyal to the king and the royalty, so one should be careful about what is said openly.
etiquette.es: Los suazis son muy leales al rey y la realeza, así que hay que cuidar lo que se dice abiertamente.
etiquette.quote: Swazis are very loyal to the king and the royalty; be smart about what is said openly.

etiquette.en: Eswatini is predominantly Christian and modesty in dress is encouraged.
etiquette.es: Esuatini es predominantemente cristiana y se fomenta la modestia en el vestir.
etiquette.quote: Eswatini is also predominantly Christian, and modesty in dress is encouraged.

etiquette.en: Calling a sangoma (traditional healer) or inyanga (herbalist) 'witch doctors' is the height of disrespect.
etiquette.es: Llamar 'brujos' a un sangoma (curandero tradicional) o inyanga (herbolario) es el colmo de la falta de respeto.
etiquette.quote: It is the height of disrespect to be disparaging towards these individuals or to refer to them as witch doctors.

etiquette.en: Male homosexuality is criminalized, though the text says the law is not enforced in practice, and LGBTQ+ Swazis face discrimination and even violence.
etiquette.es: La homosexualidad masculina está penalizada, aunque el texto dice que en la práctica no se aplica, y las personas LGBTQ+ sufren discriminación e incluso violencia.
etiquette.quote: Male homosexuality is criminalized in Eswatini, although in practice the law is not enforced.

connectivity.en: There are two mobile operators, MTN-Swazi and Eswatini Mobile, and MTN's connection is better.
connectivity.es: Hay dos operadores móviles, MTN-Swazi y Eswatini Mobile, y la conexión de MTN es mejor.
connectivity.quote: There are two wireless operators in Eswatini: MTN-Swazi and Eswatin mobile; the latter's connection is not as good as MTN's.

connectivity.en: MTN-Swazi starter packs are sold at fuel stations and grocery stores, and proof of residence, ID or passport is required.
connectivity.es: Los paquetes iniciales de MTN-Swazi se venden en gasolineras y supermercados, y se exige comprobante de residencia, identificación o pasaporte.
connectivity.quote: It's easy to buy a starter pack with an MTN-Swazi SIM card, pretty much at every fuel station or grocery store. You must provide proof of residence, ID or passport to get a pack.

connectivity.en: Starter pack SIM cards expire within 30 days if not used and cannot be used in South Africa.
connectivity.es: Las SIM de los paquetes iniciales caducan en 30 días si no se usan y no sirven en Sudáfrica.
connectivity.quote: Starter pack SIM cards expire within 30 days if not used; they cannot be used in South Africa.
